workflow.name: 💼 Office Fashion Lookbook – Thời Trang Công Sở Thanh Lịch (2 Cảnh)
workflow.description:
A TobyFlow Workflow that chains AI Models to build a multi-frame office-fashion storyboard and video, keeping the same face and outfit consistent across every shot. Perfect for workwear lookbooks and OOTD reels — automated from reference photo to finished video.

Workflow TobyFlow nối các AI Model để dựng storyboard và video thời trang công sở nhiều khung, giữ nguyên khuôn mặt và trang phục nhất quán qua mọi cảnh. Hợp lookbook đồ công sở và reels OOTD — tự động từ ảnh tham chiếu đến video hoàn chỉnh.

nodes.node_name: 📝 Prompt Ghép Ảnh 2K Công Sở Look 1
nodes.prompt:
Use the attached reference images in this exact role order:

Image 1 = FACE REFERENCE / face_reference_image

Use Image 1 only as the facial identity source.

The final woman in all 5 storyboard frames must preserve the same real facial identity from Image 1.

Since the woman wears a black face mask, prioritize preserving:

eye shape
eyelids
eyebrows
forehead structure
upper-face proportions
skin tone consistency
overall recognizable upper-face identity

The woman must still feel like the same real person from Image 1, not a generic AI woman.

Do not copy:

hairstyle
pose
outfit
lighting
background

from Image 1.

BLACK MASK REQUIREMENT

The woman must wear a realistic black face mask in all 5 storyboard frames.

The black mask must:

fully cover the nose and mouth naturally
fit tightly and realistically around the face
have premium realistic black fabric texture
show natural folds, seams, and fabric tension
remain visually identical in all frames
react naturally with lighting and movement
look physically worn and realistic

Do not generate:

floating masks
transparent masks
warped masks
deformed masks
mask clipping
unstable mask position
mask morphing between frames

Even with the mask, preserve realistic upper-face identity consistency across all frames.

Image 2 = OUTFIT REFERENCE

Use Image 2 only as the clothing source.

The woman in all 5 storyboard frames must wear the exact outfit from Image 2.

Recreate the outfit faithfully and consistently across all frames, including:

garment design
color
fabric texture
silhouette
layering
fit and proportions
collar
sleeves
seams
waistband
belt
accessories
fabric folds
wrinkles
all visible styling details

Image 2 overrides all clothing that would otherwise appear in the scene.

Do not:

keep clothing from the scene references
mix outfits
redesign clothing
simplify outfit details
beautify the outfit
change outfit structure

Image 3 = ROOM DECOR / SCENE / CAMERA REFERENCE

Use Image 3 only as the room decor, office environment, furniture, camera setup, and composition reference.

Preserve the same office atmosphere and visual layout:

gray office chair
white desk on the right side
laptop on the desk
takeaway coffee cup
bag or personal item on the desk
large floor-to-ceiling glass windows
visible exterior office building
clean modern office floor
bright minimalist office mood

Keep the same overall camera direction and framing style inspired by Image 3.

Do not use Image 3 for facial identity or outfit.

Create a single ultra-realistic storyboard image with 5 separate frames arranged as a premium editorial contact sheet.

All 5 frames must show:

the same woman
the same upper-face identity from Image 1
the same black mask
the same exact outfit from Image 2
the same office room decor from Image 3

NO TEXT REQUIREMENT

Do not include any:

text
letters
captions
weekday labels
numbers
logos
watermarks
signs
typography

The storyboard must remain purely visual.

GLOBAL CAMERA LOCK

All 5 storyboard frames must use the same camera language and visually consistent camera setup.

Keep:

the same vertical 9:16 composition feeling
the same front-facing office composition
the same subject placement
the same desk placement on the right side
the same chair placement on the left side
the same room perspective

The storyboard should feel like one fixed camera positioned in the office while the woman changes pose naturally from frame to frame.

Do not drastically change:

camera angle
lens feeling
room perspective
subject scale
camera height

GLOBAL SCENE CONSISTENCY

The room decor must remain visually consistent in all 5 frames:

gray office chair
white desk on the right
laptop on the desk
takeaway coffee cup
bag or personal item on the desk
large glass windows
visible office building outside
clean modern office floor
bright minimalist corporate atmosphere

Do not remove main furniture.

Do not add unnecessary objects.

Keep:

object scale realistic
object spacing consistent
desk reflections stable
window lighting natural
chair perspective accurate

GLOBAL CHARACTER CONSISTENCY

The woman must remain visually consistent in all 5 frames:

same upper-face identity from Image 1
same black mask
same outfit from Image 2
same body proportions
same skin tone
same hairstyle style adapted naturally to the office environment
same photorealistic appearance

FRAME-BY-FRAME ACTIONS

Frame 1

The woman is seated in the gray office chair in a relaxed elegant pose.

Her back rests lightly against the chair.

Her legs are crossed naturally.

One arm rests on the chair armrest while the other hand rests near her lap or hip.

Her head turns slightly to the left away from the desk.

Her eyes feel calm, slightly tired, and contemplative.

Frame 2

The woman sits more upright in the chair angled slightly toward the desk.

Her body posture feels more alert.

Her legs extend naturally forward.

One hand adjusts her sleeve or makes a subtle outfit-adjusting gesture.

The other arm remains relaxed.

Her head turns slightly more toward the camera.

Her eyes feel focused and ready to work.

Frame 3

The woman sits in the chair interacting with work materials.

She reads or holds a document, paper, or slim item while seated near the desk.

The laptop remains visible.

Her legs remain elegantly crossed.

Her eyes feel composed, professional, and focused.

The frame should feel calm, polished, and work-oriented.

Frame 4

The woman leans back comfortably in the office chair.

She holds a smartphone raised in front of her as if checking her phone or taking a relaxed selfie.

Her posture feels relaxed and slightly playful.

Her legs remain elegantly crossed or naturally extended.

Her eyes feel soft, relaxed, fashionable, and refined.

Frame 5

The woman sits at the desk working with the laptop.

Her body faces the desk with a poised seated posture.

One hand interacts with the laptop while the other rests naturally.

Her eyes feel focused yet relaxed like the end of a productive workday.

The frame should feel professional, polished, calm, and editorial.

REALISM REQUIREMENTS

The final storyboard must look like real fashion editorial photography, not AI-generated.

Keep:

natural skin texture
realistic forehead detail
realistic eyes and eyelashes
realistic fingers and hands
realistic body proportions
realistic black mask fabric
realistic outfit drape
authentic fabric folds
realistic chair and desk perspective
natural window lighting
soft realistic shadows
authentic office atmosphere

Do not generate:

plastic skin
waxy skin
glossy skin
doll-like appearance
over-smoothed face
fake eyes
warped anatomy
deformed fingers
CGI-looking rendering

Do not let:

the upper-face identity drift between frames
the mask deform between frames
the outfit change between frames
the office perspective change between frames

NEGATIVE PROMPT

text, letters, captions, weekday labels, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, numbers, logos, watermark, typography, misspelled text, generic AI woman, drifting upper-face identity, changed forehead structure, plastic skin, waxy skin, glossy skin, doll-like face, over-smoothed skin, fake eyes, distorted hands, extra fingers, broken fingers, deformed mask, floating mask, transparent mask, warped mask, asymmetrical mask, unstable mask position, wrong outfit, mixed outfit, simplified outfit, missing outfit details, changed office layout, changed desk placement, changed chair placement, changed camera angle, inconsistent framing, different room perspective, missing laptop, missing coffee cup, missing bag, missing windows, cartoon, CGI, 3D render, anime, illustration, low resolution, blur, compression artifacts, obvious AI generation

Important priority order:

upper-face identity consistency from Image 1 is highest priority
black mask realism and stability is second priority
outfit fidelity from Image 2 is third priority
room decor from Image 3 is fourth priority

nodes.node_name: 📝 Prompt Tạo Video Bước Đi Văn Phòng Cảnh 1
nodes.prompt:
Image 1 = FACE REFERENCE
Use Image 1 only as the facial identity source. The final woman in all storyboard frames must preserve the exact real facial identity from Image 1 as accurately as possible, including face shape, forehead, cheekbones, cheeks, jawline, chin, eyes, eyelids, eyebrows, nose shape, lips, mouth shape, skin tone, and overall facial proportions. The final face must look like the same real person from Image 1, not a similar person and not a generic AI face. Prioritize facial resemblance over beautification. Keep the face natural and photographic. Do not copy hairstyle, clothing, pose, lighting, or background from Image 1.

IMPORTANT — BLACK MASK REQUIREMENT
The woman must wear a realistic black face mask in all 5 storyboard frames.
The black mask must:

fully cover the nose and mouth naturally
fit tightly and realistically around the face
have realistic fabric texture and folds
remain consistent in all frames
not hide the upper-face identity accuracy
preserve visible identity through eyes, eyebrows, forehead, cheek structure, and facial proportions
look like a real premium black medical/fashion mask, not CGI or stylized

The mask must integrate naturally with the lighting, shadows, and skin contact.
Do not generate floating masks, distorted masks, transparent masks, or badly fitted masks.

Image 2 = OUTFIT REFERENCE
Use Image 2 only as the clothing source. The woman in all 5 storyboard frames must wear the exact outfit from Image 2. Recreate the outfit faithfully, including garment design, color, fabric texture, silhouette, layering, fit, proportions, sleeves, collar, seams, buttons, waistband, belt, accessories, folds, wrinkles, and all visible styling details. Image 2 overrides all clothing seen in Image 3. Do not keep, copy, or mix any clothing from Image 3.

Image 3 = SCENE / BACKGROUND / CAMERA REFERENCE
Use Image 3 only for the office environment, camera angle, room layout, furniture, desk arrangement, and overall visual composition. Preserve the same high-angle top-down editorial camera feeling, gray leather office chair, desk surface, silver laptop, white mouse, books, newspaper, gray floor, spacing, perspective, and modern office atmosphere. Do not use Image 3 for facial identity or outfit.

Create a single ultra-realistic storyboard image with 5 separate frames, arranged as a clean premium fashion editorial contact sheet. All 5 frames must show the same woman, with the same face identity from Image 1, the exact outfit from Image 2, and a realistic black face mask, inside the office environment from Image 3.

GLOBAL CAMERA LOCK — applies to all 5 frames

All 5 storyboard frames must use the exact same camera angle, exact same camera height, exact same overhead top-down perspective, exact same framing style, and exact same lens feeling.
The camera must remain visually locked and consistent across all 5 frames.
Do not change the shooting angle between frames.
Do not rotate, tilt, zoom dramatically, or reposition the camera.
Do not switch to a side angle, eye-level angle, lower angle, or different perspective.
Keep the same high-angle top-down editorial office camera view in every frame.
The storyboard should feel like the same camera is fixed in one position above the subject, while the woman changes pose within the same office setup.

GLOBAL SCENE CONSISTENCY

All 5 frames must preserve the same office environment and same object layout:

gray leather office chair
desk in the same position
silver laptop
white mouse
books / notebook
newspaper
gray floor
same room layout
same object scale and spacing

Do not change the environment between frames.
Do not remove or add unnecessary props.
Keep the scene visually consistent like a continuous photo sequence shot in the same place.

GLOBAL CHARACTER CONSISTENCY

The woman must remain the same person in all 5 frames:

same facial identity from Image 1
same hairstyle style based on the scene reference
same glasses
same realistic black face mask
same outfit from Image 2
same body proportions
same skin tone
same realistic appearance

FRAME ACTIONS

Frame 1:
The woman is seated in the gray office chair, reading a newspaper. One hand holds the newspaper and the other hand is lifted near her face in a thoughtful gesture. Expression through the eyes is calm, focused, and natural.

Frame 2:
The woman remains seated in the same chair and stretches both arms upward above her head. Expression through the eyes is relaxed, refreshed, and soft.

Frame 3:
The woman stands beside the desk and chair. One hand is in her pocket. Expression through the eyes is confident, elegant, and composed.

Frame 4:
The woman leans back in the office chair in a relaxed diagonal posture, with one arm extended toward the desk. Expression through the eyes is calm, reflective, and slightly tired in a natural way.

Frame 5:
The woman stands confidently near the chair and desk, facing toward the camera with elegant eye expression. Expression through the eyes is polished, poised, and engaging.

REALISM REQUIREMENTS

The final storyboard must look like a real luxury fashion editorial photo sequence, not AI-generated.

Keep:

natural skin texture
visible pores and soft imperfections
realistic forehead and eye-area detail
realistic hands and fingers
realistic eyes and eyelashes
realistic black fabric mask texture
realistic fabric folds and clothing tension
natural shadows
clean premium office lighting
realistic reflections on the desk and laptop
realistic depth and lens compression

The black mask must look physically worn and naturally integrated with the face structure.

Do not make the face glossy, waxy, plastic, overly smooth, or doll-like.

LIGHTING

Use soft, natural, balanced editorial office lighting.
Keep the lighting direction and mood consistent across all 5 frames.

Negative prompt

different identity, generic AI face, inaccurate face swap, drifting face across frames, plastic skin, waxy skin, glossy skin, over-smoothed skin, doll-like face, fake eyes, distorted hands, extra fingers, broken fingers, deformed mask, floating mask, transparent mask, asymmetrical mask, unrealistic mask, missing mask, wrong outfit, mixed outfit, original clothing from Image 3, simplified outfit, missing outfit details, changed room layout, changed camera angle, different perspective, inconsistent framing, inconsistent camera height, zoom changes, tilted camera, missing chair, missing desk, missing laptop, missing mouse, missing books, missing newspaper, cartoon, CGI, 3D render, anime, illustration, low resolution, blur, obvious AI generation
